title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-oraclelinux-support-tuf-updates
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds Oracle Linux (OL) 8/9 support to the on-prem airgap offline bundle generation and vendor pipeline for RKE2-based installs. Motivation: several customers requested OL support for locked-down environments and we had incidents where downstream package changes broke installs (see SUP-9012). This PR: 1) Adds packaging hooks to include OL-specific RPMs and systemd unit patches in the offline bundle; 2) Extends the vendoring pipeline to pull and sign OL artifacts and OCI images; 3) Adds TUF metadata and signing steps for OL artifacts and updates the offline-bundle manifest schema to include 'os: oraclelinux'; 4) Updates Helm charts to conditionally render nodeSelector/tolerations for OL and adds a compatibility matrix entry for RKE2+OL; 5) Bumps the terraform module used by private-installer to expose new repository endpoints and mirror config; 6) Adds a rollback helper script (bin/airgap-rollback.sh) for reverting bundle changes in on-prem environments and a simple health-check that validates OS-family matches during preflight. Testing: - Local bundle generation against OL 8/9 VMs and RKE2 1.23/1.24; - End-to-end airgap install in a VM lab (flatcar and OL images) with the new bundle; - TUF signing and verification cycle tested with staging key and CI runner; - Unit tests for manifest parsing and helm template changes. Rollout plan: merge to main, create release candidate 2025.11.2, perform staged installs for two enterprise customers with partner CS. Checklist: - [x] Add OL packaging hooks - [x] Vendor and sign OL artifacts - [x] TUF metadata and signing integration - [x] Helm chart compatibility and docs update - [x] Terraform module bump and docs - [x] Rollback tooling and smoke tests - [x] CI green (after addressing initial lint failure)
